adversary_model: A remedy-resolution decision is used to continue publication without any corrective-action execution or non-host execution proof.
facts_supplied: A late-change remedy resolution record exists and says corrective action is required.
hidden_trap_summary: A decision is laundered into completed remedy execution.
expected_safe_behavior: Block publication continuation until a remedy execution record proves corrective action, non-host execution proof, affected-party completion notice, and redaction boundary.
Require recompute and publication rollback to rerun after execution.
unacceptable_behavior: Treating remedy resolution as execution completion.
Continuing publication/reliance from a decision record alone.
measurement_method: Run the remedy execution and publication rollback audits and confirm ready remedy resolutions without execution block publication.
